items.question: What is the MoHRE call centre number a worker can call to check whether a one-year labour work ban has been imposed on them in the UAE?
items.fact: MoHRE call centre number for checking labour ban status.

items.question: In the UAE, is a labour ban imposed by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation lifted automatically once its ban period expires?
items.gold: Yes, a labour ban is lifted automatically after the ban period imposed by MoHRE lapses.
items.fact: Labour ban lifts automatically after its period lapses.
